channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 9-10, 2026
item.description: Weekend sports lineup: full slate of high school hoops, swimming and wrestling plus Barton College basketball, swimming and bowling across the area Jan. 9-10, 2026.

item.title: Bulldogs squander lead in 1-point loss at Ferrum
item.description: Barton squandered a 14-point halftime cushion as Ferrum, powered by Gerren Jones’ 34 points and hot second-half shooting, rallied for a 79-78 win and the Bulldogs’ third straight loss.

item.title: MIDDLE SCHOOL ROUNDUP: CCS girls 6-1 after beating Hope Prep
item.description: Community Christian girls improve to 6-1 with a dominant win at Hope Prep, Elm City girls edge Darden, and Darden boys stay unbeaten with a rout of Elm City.

item.title: Sleight powers BC women past Ferrum to stay atop East
item.description: Layne Sleight’s 18-point double-double and Barton's late surge lifted the Bulldogs past Ferrum 54-49, keeping them atop the Conference Carolinas East Division race.

item.title: AREA ROUNDUP: Chargers thump Friendship Christian for 6th win
item.description: Wilson Christian’s boys and girls routed Friendship Christian, Wilson Prep girls stretched their win streak to six, and Community Christian’s unbeaten run ended in a busy local hoops slate.

item.title: Dryer fire causes property damage at assisted living facility
item.description: Dryer fire at Wilson nursing home quickly contained by staff; residents sheltered in place, no injuries reported, damage limited to contents estimated at $10,000.

item.title: Community briefs: Meetings and more planned in coming weeks
item.description: Upcoming events include free hot meals, political meetups, book donation drive and Bible college registration.

item.title: Larry the robot maps city sidewalks for ADA compliance
item.description: An AI robot named Larry is mapping downtown sidewalks for ADA compliance, giving the first East Coast city a precise, data-driven repair plan.

item.title: Man charged with Speedway robbery
item.description: A Wilson man charged with armed robbery is also accused of kidnapping three and possessing a firearm as a felon.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson selects Wilson for second facility
item.description: Johnson & Johnson will build a second multi‑billion dollar manufacturing plant in Wilson, creating up to 500 jobs and expanding biotech training ties with Wilson Community College. Local officials are praising the teamwork that helped make it happen.
